description: Short real-run smoke for 25_mae: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. MAE's model is parameterisable (models/mae_vit.py: 'the architecture is parameterisable so a smoke can build a tiny one'), so the default ViT-Large is shrunk to a tiny ViT via the encoder/decoder dim keys -- applied identically in both stages so linear_eval rebuilds the same encoder that encoder.pt holds. train.img_size (64) stays divisible by the patch size 16.
